about: Development set for the claim-type marker (F7) and the inference-gap marker (F9). Sentences shaped like the X discourse study of 2026-10-25 and the worked example of 2026-10-26, with invented or paraphrased wording; labelled by Claude (Opus 5.5) on 2026-10-26. The rules were tuned on this set. type: question | quotation | definition | sourced statement | classification | inference | opinion or value | factual claim, no source | factual claim with a link | statement. gap: none | mind | leap.
